title: Career Roadmap · Embroidery Designer
summary: An Embroidery Designer creates decorative stitch patterns and motifs for garments, accessories and textiles, using hand embroidery, machine embroidery or digital design software for fashion and production applications.

facts.Current degree: ITI Cutting & Sewing / Fashion Design & Technology / Embroidery

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 for relevant vocational training; Class 12 can broaden further-study options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream may suit many embroidery and fashion-design pathways; check specific course criteria.

blocks.label: Explore

blocks.label: Early skills

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Fabric types, colour theory, motif drawing and hand-embroidery stitches.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Pattern placement, thread selection, decorative stitches and garment embellishment.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Embroidery digitizing, machine settings, stitch density and design-file preparation.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Build a motif portfolio, test designs on different fabrics and check production quality.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Create a floral motif collection • Embroider a garment panel • Digitize a simple logo • Compare thread and stitch combinations on different fabrics.
